text: The fundamental theorem of Galois theory establishes a correspondence between:
choices: intermediate fields F⊆L⊆K and subgroups of Gal(K/F)
explanation: Galois correspondence: for a Galois extension K/F, there is an order-reversing bijection between subfields F⊆L⊆K and subgroups H≤Gal(K/F), with L fixed by H and [K:L]=[H:1].
